summary: Newly granted permissions no longer show as missing while they take effect.

fixes.title: No false missing access after new permissions
fixes.text: Right after new permissions are granted, the database job and support access no longer show as missing or blocked. A membership that cannot be read yet shows as not yet known.

fixes.title: Least-privilege check keeps its result
fixes.text: The database least-privilege check keeps its result after the updater leaves the database admin group.
